ROW.COLUMN: (FR/EE) Suspicious Transactions Linked to Employee: Below Internal Limits

This scenario detects suspicious account transfers or journals made by employees and employee related accounts just below the internal limits that require secondary or higher level approval within the organization. For the Employees monitor activities in accounts either directly controlled (owned) by employees, or accounts that are controlled by employee family members. The monitored activities in the employee-related accounts are usually related to trading activities initiated by employees who directly or indirectly are involved in customer order handling and/or trade executions. Those employees who act as trader representatives do not have discretionary authority over accounts, but place and execute orders as directed by others, and by doing so have access to insider information. This scenario generates an alert when the aggregate daily amount, or two other adjustable consecutive day aggregate amounts, of deposits/withdrawal are higher than specific predetermined thresholds during the Lookback Period.

SELECT a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID, b.ACCT_INTRL_ID, a.HH_ACCT_GRP_ID, c.NVSMT_MGR_SEQ_ID FROM @BUSINESS@.NVSMT_MGR c inner join @BUSINESS@.MANGD_ACCT b inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT a on (b.ACCT_INTRL_ID=a.ACCT_INTRL_ID) on (c.NVSMT_MGR_INTRL_ID=b.NVSMT_MGR_INTRL_ID)
SELECT a.HH_ACCT_GRP_ID, a.ACCT_INTRL_ID, a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID, b.EMP_ACCT_SEQ_ID FROM @BUSINESS@.ACCT a inner join @BUSINESS@.EMP_ACCT b on (a.ACCT_INTRL_ID=b.ACCT_INTRL_ID)

WITH
-- To get the Employee and Employee Related Account details for the filters
T1 AS (SELECT E.EMP_INTRL_ID , E.EMP_SEQ_ID , BOT.EXCTN_DT , SUM(BOT.TRXN_BASE_AM ) TRXN_BASE_AM , COUNT(DISTINCT BOT.ACCT_INTRL_ID) NO_OF_ACCTS , MAX(BOT.BO_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB ) ACTVY_RISK , MAX(A.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB) EFCTV_RISK , COUNT( BOT.BO_TRXN_SEQ_ID ) TRXN_CT
FROM
@BUSINESS@.NTWK_USER_ACCT_MAP NUAM INNER JOIN @BUSINESS@.ACCT A ON A.ACCT_INTRL_ID = NUAM.ACCT_INTRL_ID INNER JOIN @BUSINESS@.BACK_OFFICE_TRXN BOT ON A.ACCT_INTRL_ID = BOT.ACCT_INTRL_ID INNER JOIN @BUSINESS@.EMP E ON NUAM.EMP_INTRL_ID = E.EMP_INTRL_ID
WHERE --Exclude Exempt Accounts A.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 -- Include Oracle Business Acct Types AND A.MANTAS_ACCT_BUS_TYPE_CD in (@Business_Acct_Types) -- Include Credit or Debit activity AND BOT.DBT_CDT_CD=@Credit_Debit_Code --Exclude Distribution, Dividend, Fee, Interest, and Transfer-of-Account Transactions AND BOT.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' AND BOT.UNRLTD_PARTY_CD is NOT NULL --Exclude cancelled transactions AND BOT.CXL_PAIR_TRXN_INTRL_ID is NULL -- Include all Jurisdiction Codes AND (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' OR E.JRSDCN_CD IN (@Incld_Jurisdictions_Lst)) -- Include all Transaction Source Codes AND (@All_Trans_Src_Fl = 'Y' OR BOT.SRC_SYS_CD IN (@Incld_Trans_Src_Lst)) -- Lookback Period AND BOT.EXCTN_DT <= (SELECT CL.CLNDR_DT FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL CL WHERE CL.CLNDR_NM =@Calendar_Name AND CL.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) AND BOT.EXCTN_DT > (SELECT CL.CLNDR_DT FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL CL WHERE CL.CLNDR_NM =@Calendar_Name AND CL.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = @lookback_period+(GREATEST(@Day_Range_2, @Day_Range_3) -1)) AND BOT.DATA_DUMP_DT <= (SELECT CL.CLNDR_DT FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL CL WHERE CL.CLNDR_NM =@Calendar_Name AND CL.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) AND BOT.DATA_DUMP_DT > (SELECT CL.CLNDR_DT FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL CL WHERE CL.CLNDR_NM =@Calendar_Name AND CL.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = @lookback_period+(GREATEST(@Day_Range_2, @Day_Range_3)-1)) GROUP BY E.EMP_INTRL_ID, E.EMP_SEQ_ID, BOT.EXCTN_DT ORDER BY E.EMP_INTRL_ID,BOT.EXCTN_DT)
,
-- To get all the records within lookback period T2 AS
(SELECT KC.CLNDR_DT FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_DAY_AGE >= 0 AND KC.CLNDR_DAY_AGE < @lookback_period+(GREATEST(@Day_Range_2, @Day_Range_3)-1) AND KC.CLNDR_NM = @Calendar_Name ORDER BY KC.CLNDR_DT )
,
-- Calculate the Daily Aggregate Amount
C1 AS ( SELECT T1.EMP_INTRL_ID , T1.EMP_SEQ_ID , T2.CLNDR_DT -- Daily Aggregate Amount , SUM(CASE WHEN (T2.CLNDR_DT=T1.EXCTN_DT) THEN T1.TRXN_BASE_AM ELSE 0 END) TRANS_AM , MAX(T1.NO_OF_ACCTS) ACCT_CT , MAX(T1.ACTVY_RISK) ACTVY_RSK , MAX(T1.EFCTV_RISK) EFCTV_RSK -- Daily Aggregate Transaction Count , SUM(CASE WHEN (T2.CLNDR_DT=T1.EXCTN_DT) THEN T1.TRXN_CT ELSE 0 END) TRXN_CT , MAX(CASE WHEN (T2.CLNDR_DT=T1.EXCTN_DT) THEN T1.EXCTN_DT ELSE NULL END) MAX_EXCTN_DT FROM T1,T2 GROUP BY T1.EMP_INTRL_ID,T1.EMP_SEQ_ID,T2.CLNDR_DT ORDER BY T1.EMP_INTRL_ID,T2.CLNDR_DT )
,
-- Calculate the 2 Day Aggregate Amount C2 AS
(SELECT EMP_INTRL_ID , EMP_SEQ_ID , CLNDR_DT , TRANS_AM -- if the daily amount is greater than 0 and less than Lower End of Range 1,2 Day Aggregate Amount is calculated. -- 2 Day Aggregate Amount is calculated for the Day Range 2 consecutive days back office transaction debit (credit) amount. , (CASE WHEN TRANS_AM > 0 AND TRANS_AM <@Lower_End_of_Range1 THEN SUM(TRANS_AM) OVER (PARTITION BY EMP_INTRL_ID ORDER BY CLNDR_DT ROWS (@Day_Range_2-1) PRECEDING) ELSE 0 END )DAY2_AGGR_VAL , ACCT_CT , ACTVY_RSK , EFCTV_RSK , TRXN_CT -- To check the Frequency period , MAX(MAX_EXCTN_DT) OVER (PARTITION BY EMP_INTRL_ID) MAX_EXCTN_DT FROM C1 )
,
-- Calculate the 3 Day Aggregate Amount TRXN AS
(SELECT EMP_INTRL_ID , EMP_SEQ_ID , CLNDR_DT , TRANS_AM , DAY2_AGGR_VAL -- if the daily amount is greater than 0 and less than Lower End of Range 1 and -- if the 2 Day Aggregate Amount is greater than 0 and less than Lower End of Range 2, 3 Day Aggregate Amount is calculated. -- 3 Day Aggregate Amount is calculated for the Day Range 3 consecutive days back office transaction debit (credit) amount. , (CASE WHEN ((TRANS_AM > 0 AND TRANS_AM <@Lower_End_of_Range1) AND (DAY2_AGGR_VAL > 0 AND DAY2_AGGR_VAL< @Lower_End_of_Range2)) THEN SUM(TRANS_AM) OVER (PARTITION BY EMP_INTRL_ID ORDER BY CLNDR_DT ROWS (@Day_Range_3-1) PRECEDING) ELSE 0 END )DAY3_AGGR_VAL , ACCT_CT , ACTVY_RSK , EFCTV_RSK , TRXN_CT -- To get the previous day record in order to calculate the transaction count , RANK()OVER (PARTITION BY EMP_INTRL_ID ORDER BY CLNDR_DT) RNK FROM C2
-- Frequency period WHERE C2.MAX_EXCTN_DT > (SELECT ADD_DAYS(CL.CLNDR_DT, -@frequency_Period) FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL CL WHERE CL.CLNDR_NM =@Calendar_Name AND CL.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) ) ,
-- To get the Total Transaction Amountt,Total Transaction Count and Occurrence Count for Employee AGGT_TRXN AS
(SELECT X.EMP_INTRL_ID -- Aggregate amount of transactions , SUM(X.TRANS_AM) TRANS_AM -- Total transaction count , SUM(X.TRXN_CT) TRXN_CT -- Number of occurrence of aggregated transaction amount , SUM(X.OCCRNC_CNT) OCCRNC_CNT
FROM -- Daily transaction amount and transaction count ( SELECT EMP_INTRL_ID , CLNDR_DT , TRANS_AM , TRXN_CT , SUM(OCCRNC_CNT) OCCRNC_CNT FROM ( SELECT T.EMP_INTRL_ID , T.CLNDR_DT , T.TRANS_AM TRANS_AM , T.TRXN_CT TRXN_CT , 1 OCCRNC_CNT FROM TRXN T --Number of days with daily back office transaction debit (credit) amount between Lower End of Range 1 and Upper End of Range 1 WHERE T.TRANS_AM BETWEEN @Lower_End_of_Range1 AND @Upper_End_of_Range1
UNION
-- 2 Day transaction amount and transaction count for current day and (Day_Range_2-1)
SELECT D2.EMP_INTRL_ID , D2.CLNDR_DT , D2.TRANS_AM , D2.TRXN_CT , (CASE WHEN DIFF = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT FROM ( SELECT A1.EMP_INTRL_ID , A1.CLNDR_DT DAY2_DT , B1.CLNDR_DT CLNDR_DT , B1.TRANS_AM,(A1.RNK-B1.RNK)DIFF , B1.TRXN_CT FROM TRXN A1,TRXN B1 -- Number of days with Day Range 2 consecutive days back office transaction debit (credit) amount between Lower End of Range 2 and Upper End of Range 2 WHERE A1.DAY2_AGGR_VAL BETWEEN @Lower_End_of_Range2 AND @Upper_End_of_Range2 AND A1.EMP_INTRL_ID=B1.EMP_INTRL_ID ) D2 --Day Range 2 consecutive days back office transaction WHERE DIFF BETWEEN 0 AND (@Day_Range_2-1)
UNION
--3 Day transaction amount and transaction count for current day and (Day_Range_3-1)
SELECT D3.EMP_INTRL_ID , D3.CLNDR_DT , D3.TRANS_AM , D3.TRXN_CT , (CASE WHEN DIFF = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT FROM ( SELECT A1.EMP_INTRL_ID , A1.CLNDR_DT DAY2_DT , B1.CLNDR_DT CLNDR_DT , B1.TRANS_AM,(A1.RNK-B1.RNK)DIFF , B1.TRXN_CT FROM TRXN A1,TRXN B1 -- Number of days with Day Range 3 consecutive days back office transaction debit (credit) amount between Lower End of Range 3 and Upper End of Range 3 WHERE A1.DAY3_AGGR_VAL BETWEEN @Lower_End_of_Range3 AND @Upper_End_of_Range3 AND A1.EMP_INTRL_ID=B1.EMP_INTRL_ID )D3 --Day Range 3 consecutive days back office transaction WHERE DIFF BETWEEN 0 AND (@Day_Range_3-1) ) GROUP BY EMP_INTRL_ID, CLNDR_DT, TRANS_AM, TRXN_CT)X GROUP BY X.EMP_INTRL_ID) -- To get the Total Transaction Amountt,Total Transaction Count and Occurrence Count involved in the alert. SELECT DISTINCT T.EMP_INTRL_ID , T.EMP_SEQ_ID ,(CASE WHEN AX.TRANS_AM - TRUNC( AX.TRANS_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN AX.TRANS_AM ELSE 0 END) "LRF_TRXN_AMT" , AX.TRANS_AM "TOTAL_TRXN_AMT" , AX.TRXN_CT "TOTAL_TRXN_COUNT" , AX.OCCRNC_CNT "OCCURANCE_COUNT" , T.ACTVY_RSK "ACTIVITY_RISK_LEVEL" , (CASE WHEN T.EFCTV_RSK >= @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl AND T.ACTVY_RSK >= @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl THEN 'HR' WHEN T.EFCTV_RSK < @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl AND T.ACTVY_RSK < @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl THEN 'RR' ELSE 'MR' END) "OVERALL_RISK" , T.EFCTV_RSK "EFFECTIVE_RISK_LEVEL" , T.ACCT_CT "NO_OF_ACCTS" , (SELECT MAX(CL.CLNDR_DT) FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL CL WHERE CL.CLNDR_NM =@Calendar_Name AND CL.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) CURR_DATE
FROM TRXN T INNER JOIN AGGT_TRXN AX ON T.EMP_INTRL_ID=AX.EMP_INTRL_ID -- Minimum Number of occurrences during the specified lookback period required for alerting on the focal entity WHERE AX.OCCRNC_CNT >=@Min_Occurrence_Ct -- Exclude the Employees who dont have Minimum account number AND T.ACCT_CT >=@Min_Acct_Ct
